Summary

PAUDBUNL is a batch IMS database unload program that reads Pending Authorization Summary (root) segments and their associated Pending Authorization Detail (child) segments from an IMS database, then writes the extracted records to two sequential output files for downstream processing. The program iterates through all root segments using a Get Next (GN) call and retrieves corresponding child segments using a Get Next within Parent (GNP) call, writing summary records to OPFILE1 and detail records to OPFILE2.
- **Execution Environment**: Batch - **Database Access**: IMS - **MQ Calls**: No - **Module Type**: Main module
### Key Functionalities: 1: Program Initialization - Accept and display the current date, then open two sequential output files (Summary File and Details File) for writing 2: Read Pending Authorization Summary Record - Retrieve the next root-level Pending Authorization Summary segment from the IMS database using an unqualified Get Next (GN) call 3: Validate Summary Record - Check if the retrieved summary record has a numeric Account ID; only process records with valid numeric Account IDs 4: Write Summary Record to Output File - Move the Pending Authorization Summary data to the first output file record and write it to the Summary output file 5: Increment Summary Record Counters - Add 1 to the total summary records read counter and the authorization summary processed counter each time a valid summary record is retrieved 6: Read Pending Authorization Detail Record - For each summary record, retrieve the next child-level Pending Authorization Detail segment from the IMS database using an unqualified Get Next within Parent (GNP) call 7: Write Detail Record to Output File - Move the Pending Authorization Detail data along with the parent Account ID key to the second output file record and write it to the Details output file 8: Increment Detail Record Counters - Add 1 to the total summary records read counter and the authorization summary processed counter each time a valid detail record is retrieved 9: Detect End of Child Segments - When the IMS GNP call returns a 'GE' (Segment Not Found) status, mark the end-of-child-segment flag as 'Y' to stop reading detail records for the current summary 10: Detect End of Database - When the IMS GN call returns a 'GB' (End of Database) status, mark the end-of-root-segment flag as 'Y' to stop processing all summary records 11: Process All Summary and Detail Records - Repeatedly read each Pending Authorization Summary record and for each summary, read all its associated Pending Authorization Detail child records until the entire database is exhausted 12: Close Output Files - Close both the Summary output file and the Details output file after all records have been processed 13: Abnormal Program Termination - If any unexpected error occurs during file operations or IMS database calls, display an error message and terminate the program with a return code of 16

Datasource Information (4)

Datasource Name Type Usage
PAUTSUM0 (PENDING-AUTH-SUMMARY) IMS Segment Read - Root segment containing Pending Authorization Summary data, retrieved sequentially using GN (Get Next) call
PAUTDTL1 (PENDING-AUTH-DETAILS) IMS Segment Read - Child segment containing Pending Authorization Detail data, retrieved using GNP (Get Next within Parent) call for each root segment
OPFILE1 Sequential File Write - Output file receiving Pending Authorization Summary (root segment) records
OPFILE2 Sequential File Write - Output file receiving Pending Authorization Detail (child segment) records
